messages:
Emma C: FYI - we're seeing onboarding API timeouts for new tenants created between 03:10-03:35 UTC in eu-west-1. ~18% of provisioning calls are 504s. flagging for CS so we can notify affected customers ASAP. :rotating_light:
Sam O: thanks - ops is on it. we're throttling bursts to a fallback pool now, should reduce error rate. rolling patch ETA 25m.
Jamal R: root cause looks like a regression in prefix-cache eviction under heavy parallel import. patch merges into canary, perf tests look good. will promote after canary run.
Priya S: can we get a quick list of impacted tenant IDs + contacts? I can start drafting outreach while you confirm scope.
Sam O: grabbing list now from the incident query. will post in a sec.
incident-bot: Incident #INC-2026-238: Onboarding API 504s in eu-west-1. Severity: P2. Affected services: onboarding orchestration, webhook delivery.
Sam O: posted list to GDrive: https://redwood.internal/g/INC-2026-238/impacted-tenants (internal link). 23 tenants total, 9 high-touch (enterprise), 14 self-serve.
Olivia P: Enterprise CS - heads up: 9 enterprise tenants flagged, include renewal-facing contacts in the outreach. we'll offer immediate live troubleshooting and a one-time service credit if they had onboarding failures.
Emma C: Draft message (short):

Priya S: "Hi <Name>,
We experienced transient timeouts while completing onboarding for accounts created between 03:10-03:35 UTC in eu-west-1. Our engineering team mitigated the issue at 03:45 UTC and restarted the affected jobs. If you saw incomplete imports or failed webhooks, we can re-run your onboarding or assist live. We're offering a one-time account credit and a post-mortem summary once available.
Apologies for the disruption — please reply here or book office hours: https://cal.com/redwood/cs.
Best, Priya on behalf of Redwood CS"

Emma C: Thoughts? keep it short, empathetic, and say what we did + next steps.
Priya S: propose adding: "If you'd like us to re-run imports, reply with the dataset ID and preferred window."
Jamal R: add: "We patched prefix-cache eviction logic; no customer data was exposed or lost. Full RCA will follow."
Olivia P: add renewal note for enterprise: "We understand timing matters for your rollout; if this impacts an imminent launch or renewal decision, we'll prioritize onboarding assistance and open a dedicated bridge."
Emma C: ok final draft assembled. who will send?
Priya S: I can send to the 14 self-serve and low-touch. Emma — can you or someone on the enterprise CS team send the 9 high-touch with the tailored line about a dedicated bridge?
Emma C: I'll own enterprise sends. Sam - can ops annotate ticket with timeline + logs we can paste in the enterprise notes?
Sam O: yes - I'll add a short timeline and attach the canary run logs.
Jamal R: patch promoted to prod at 03:44 UTC. error rate dropped from 18% -> 0.8% within 3 minutes of promotion. will follow up with deeper RCA doc in ~48 hours.
Priya S: sending to self-serve now. copy of message saved to GDrive draft at https://redwood.internal/g/INC-2026-238/cs-drafts
Emma C: enterprise outreach starts in 15m. Priya/Olivia — let's coordinate the bridge times.
Olivia P: scheduling bridge for impacted enterprise tenants 04:15-05:30 UTC. calendar invites going out.
Priya S: quick Q - do we want to proactively issue credits or wait for customer reply?
Emma C: proactively for enterprise. for self-serve, wait to confirm failure then apply credit on request.
Sam O: ops will tag tenants with "onboard-504" label so CS can filter quickly.
Jamal R: adding technical note: the root cause was a heuristics change in the cache that increased eviction under N concurrent imports; edge-case only for long-run concurrent onboarding spikes. Patch reverts heuristics + adds safety limit.
Priya S: received a reply from BetaCorp (enterprise) asking for immediate re-run and an exec note. Emma — can you handle exec?
Emma C: yes - will prepare a short exec summary and runbook for the bridge.
Olivia P: also track renewal risk flag on those 9 tenants. put a note in Salesforce: "INC-2026-238 - onboarding delay".
Priya S: customers contacted: 14 self-serve messages sent, 3 replies already (2 requests for re-run, 1 confirmation no impact).
Sam O: monitoring looks stable. keeping alert window open for 6h.
Jamal R: saving logs and RCA draft to the incident folder. I'll ping here when the 48h RCA is ready for review.
Emma C: great work everyone. let's reconvene in 2h to review any enterprise escalations. :thumbsup:
